# micro.hazwoper

> Bite-size HAZWOPER training: PPE levels, decontamination, air monitoring and site characterization in 15-20 minutes, plus one-hour spill equipment courses. From $12.99.

micro.hazwoper (https://micro-modules.hazwoperosha.us/) sells online training from HAZWOPER OSHA Training, LLC (https://hazwoper-osha.com/). Courses are 100% online and self-paced, and each includes a certificate of completion. Prices are per seat; seats for a whole crew can be bought in one checkout. Phone +1-866-429-6742, email info@hazwoper-osha.com.

## When to use this site

- Use it when someone needs PPE Levels A–D, Decontamination, Air Monitoring, Site Characterization or related training, wants to compare those courses, or needs to know what a regulation requires them to take.
- Each course page lists the length, the price per seat, the regulation it covers, what it teaches and who it's for.
- To enroll, open a course's enroll link below. It opens the checkout on that page; payment is by card through Stripe. For an invoice or purchase order, call +1-866-429-6742 or email info@hazwoper-osha.com.
- Every page is also served as Markdown: send `Accept: text/markdown`, or add `.md` to the path (https://micro-modules.hazwoperosha.us/index.md).

## Guides

- [PPE levels A, B, C and D on one page](https://micro-modules.hazwoperosha.us/guides/ppe-levels-cheat-sheet): The fastest way to remember what each level of protection includes and when it's used.
- [Using micro-modules for toolbox talks](https://micro-modules.hazwoperosha.us/guides/micro-modules-for-toolbox-talks): A 15-minute lesson fits a morning tailgate. Here's how to run one, and what micro-modules can't replace.
- [The decon line, station by station](https://micro-modules.hazwoperosha.us/guides/decon-line-station-by-station): Why decon goes in a fixed order, and the mistakes that send contamination home with workers.
